units.source_text: 大公主伸出那双晶莹洁白的玉手，用纸包的冰揩拭一下，说道：“我不要拿，滴下水来很讨厌。”

en.t: The First Princess stretched out her crystal-clear, white jade-like hands, wiped them with ice wrapped in paper, and said, "I do not want to hold it; it is unpleasant when water drips."

units.source_text: 薰大将隐约听见她的声音，也觉得无限欢喜。

en.t: General Kaoru faintly heard her voice, and he too felt immeasurable joy.

units.source_text: 他想：“还在她很小的时候，我见过她。

en.t: He thought, "I saw her when she was still very small.

units.source_text: 那时我自己也还是个无知无识的小儿，就觉得这女孩相貌真漂亮。

en.t: At that time I myself was still an ignorant little child, yet I thought this girl was truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 后来就彼此隔绝，连情况也不明。

en.t: Afterward we were cut off from each other, and I did not even know how she was.

units.source_text: 今天是什么神佛赏赐我这个好机会？

en.t: What god or Buddha has granted me this wonderful chance today?

units.source_text: 唉，这是否也会同从前一样，成为忧愁苦患的起因呢？”

en.t: Ah, will this too, as before, become the cause of sorrow and suffering?"

units.source_text: 他不安地想着，痴立在那里凝望。

en.t: He thought uneasily and stood there in a daze, gazing at her.

units.source_text: 此时正在北面乘凉的一个女仆，忽然想起：

en.t: Just then, a maidservant who was cooling herself on the north side suddenly remembered:

units.source_text: 自己因有要事，打开这纸隔扇走了出来，不曾关上。

en.t: Because she had some urgent business, she had opened this paper sliding partition and gone out, but had not closed it.

units.source_text: 如果有人在这里窥探，自己将大受呵斥。

en.t: If anyone were peering in from here, she would be severely scolded.

units.source_text: 她很担心，立刻慌张地跑回来。

en.t: She was very worried and immediately ran back in a panic.

units.source_text: 但见一个穿便袍的男子站在那里，不知是谁。

en.t: But she saw a man in informal court robes standing there and did not know who he was.

units.source_text: 她心中惶恐，也顾不得自己被人看见，

en.t: Terrified at heart, she no longer cared whether she herself was seen,

units.source_text: 就沿着回廊急急忙忙地奔来。

en.t: and hurried along the corridor at a run.

units.source_text: 薰大将想：“我这种好色的行为，决不可叫人看见。”

en.t: General Kaoru thought, "This amorous behavior of mine must absolutely not be seen by anyone."

units.source_text: 立刻转身离去，躲藏起来。

en.t: He immediately turned away, left, and hid himself.

units.source_text: 那女仆想道：“不得了啊！

en.t: The maidservant thought, "This is terrible!

units.source_text: 连帷屏都没有遮好，望进去全都看见！

en.t: Even the curtain screens were not properly set, so everything inside could be seen by looking in!

units.source_text: 这官人大约是左大臣家的公子吧？

en.t: This gentleman is probably the son of the Minister of the Left's family, is he not?

units.source_text: 陌生人不会到这里来。

en.t: No stranger would come here.

units.source_text: 如果被人知道了，一定会追究：

en.t: If people find out, they will certainly investigate:

units.source_text: ‘是谁把纸隔扇打开的？

en.t: 'Who opened the paper sliding partition?
